Definition: from G4862 and G5530; to use jointly, i.e. (by implication) to hold intercourse in common:--have dealings with.
BiblicalUsage: The woman of Samaria asks Jesus how He, being a Jew, asks drink of her, a Samaritan woman, for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans. The word is dealings, the ordinary traffic of life, and the wall between the peoples is so high that even a drink of water cannot cross it, until Jesus asks for one.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jesus crosses walls that religion builds, and I believe a drink of water offered across the divide can be the beginning of the gospel.
